candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating ReadTimeout through inventory to order to gateway; redis is the deepest failing dependency in the topology.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs admitted; whether redis itself is slow vs. network/config is unconfirmed. Order/payment/postgres show no failing dependency operations.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failure driven by redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory, surfacing as 503 on /v1/reservations and 502 on /v1/orders and /v1/checkout. Gateway and order metrics confirm 502s on checkout/orders with ~2.4s p95. Payment and postgres dependency operations show no errors. Bounded candidate: redis timeout on inventory's reserve path.
